Yaqeenan pesh aane waali Qiyaamat
Aur kaisi pesh aane waali
Aur tum kya jaano ke ye yaqeenan pesh aane waali shai kya hai
Qaum-e-Samood o Aad ne is khadkhadaane waali ka inkaar kiya tha
To Samood ek chinghaad ke zariye halaak kar diye gaye
Aur Aad ko intihaai tez o tund aandhi se barbaad kar diya gaya
Jise un ke oopar saat raat aur aath din ke liye musalsal musakhkhar kar diya gaya, to tum dekhte ho ke qaum bilkul murda padi hui hai jaise khokhle khajoor ke darakht ke tane
To kya tum un ka koi baaqi rehne waala hissa dekh rahe ho
Aur Fir'aun aur us se pehle aur ulti bastiyon waale sab ne ghaltiyon ka irtikaab kiya hai
Ke Parwardigar ke numaainde ki naafarmaani ki, to Parwardigar ne unhein badi sakhti se pakad liya
Hum ne tum ko us waqt kashti mein utha liya tha jab paani sar se chadh raha tha
Taake ise tumhaare liye naseehat banaayen aur mehfooz rakhne waale kaan sun lein
Phir jab Soor mein pehli martaba phoonka jaaega
Aur zameen aur pahaadon ko ukhaad kar takra kar reza reza kar diya jaaega
To us din Qiyaamat waaqe ho jaaegi
Aur aasmaan shaqq ho kar bilkul phus-phuse ho jaayenge
Aur farishte us ke atraaf par honge aur Arsh-e-Ilaahi ko us din aath farishte uthaaye honge
Us din tum ko manzar-e-aam par laaya jaaega aur tumhaari koi baat posheeda na rahegi
Phir jis ko naama-e-aamaal daahine haath mein diya jaaega woh sab se kahega ke zara mera naama-e-aamaal to padho
Mujhe pehle hi maaloom tha ke mera hisaab mujhe milne waala hai
Phir woh pasandeeda zindagi mein hoga
Buland-tareen baaghaat mein
Us ke mewe qareeb qareeb honge
Ab aaraam se khaao piyo ke tum ne guzishta dinon mein in ne'maton ka intizaam kiya hai
Lekin jis ko naama-e-aamaal baayen haath mein diya jaaega woh kahega: aye kaash ye naama-e-aamaal mujhe na diya jaata
Aur mujhe apna hisaab na maaloom hota
Aye kaash isi maut ne mera faisla kar diya hota
Mera maal bhi mere kaam na aaya
Aur meri hukoomat bhi barbaad ho gayi
Ab ise pakdo aur giraftaar kar lo
Phir ise Jahannam mein jhonk do
Phir ek sattar gaz ki rassi mein ise jakad lo
Ye Khuda-e-Azeem par imaan nahin rakhta tha
Aur logon ko miskeenon ko khilaane par aamaada nahin karta tha
To aaj is ka yahaan koi ghamkhwaar nahin hai
Aur na peep ke ilaawa koi ghiza hai
Jise gunaahgaaron ke ilaawa koi nahin kha sakta
Main us ki bhi qasam khaata hoon jise tum dekh rahe ho
Aur us ki bhi jis ko nahin dekh rahe ho
Ke ye ek mohtaram farishte ka bayaan hai
Aur ye kisi shaayar ka qaul nahin hai, haan tum bahut kam imaan laate ho
Aur ye kisi kaahin ka kalaam nahin hai jis par tum bahut kam ghaur karte ho
Ye Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka naazil-karda hai
Aur agar ye Paighambar hamaari taraf se koi baat gadh leta
To hum is ke haath ko pakad lete
Aur phir is ki gardan uda dete
Phir tum mein se koi mujhe rokne waala na hota
Aur ye Qur'an saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye naseehat hai
Aur hum jaante hain ke tum mein se jhutlaane waale bhi hain
Aur ye kaafireen ke liye baais-e-hasrat hai
Aur ye bilkul yaqeeni cheez hai
Lehaaza aap apne azeem Parwardigar ke naam ki tasbeeh karein
